name: heston-flow-matching-seed0-500epochs
preprocessing: Same core route as the 300-epoch fit: spot-normalized prices divided by fixed quote-noise SD; fresh standard-normal training quote errors; fixed noisy validation; physical bounded targets through logit adapter, float32 conversion and learned standardization. No test arrays are opened.
optimizer: Fresh run: AdamW, weight_decay=.005, clipnorm=1.5, 5% warmup to .0005 then cosine decay to zero across the declared total updates.
selection: Minimum validation loss within this family, then exact same-device seeded reload check. Loss values are not compared across spline likelihood and flow-matching regression objectives.

course_relationship.archived_training: 500 epochs, 4x256, seed0, 50k training/5k validation, fresh quote noise, alpha=-.5; 100 nonuniform Euler steps dense at the data endpoint t=1.
course_relationship.new_training: 500 epochs, 4x256, seed0, existing20k training/5k validation; current factory default alpha=-.5 with t=1-u^(1+alpha), data endpoint t=0.
course_relationship.new_sampling: Current BF2.1 factory: 100 uniform Euler steps from noise t=1 to data t=0; no archived reversed/nonuniform grid is injected.
course_relationship.limitation: A course-style architecture in the shared BF2.1 workflow, not an identical replication. Training bank size, endpoint conventions/time distribution, sampler grid and framework differ. A failed comparison can include solver error; sampler refinement is a separate check, not evidence that more training data is needed.

stop_rule: Stop this one run on any failure or stage/whole-job time limit; retain committed training checkpoints and incomplete stages. No automatic retry, schedule extension, new data or test evaluation.
